Body.Content:
Provides a time zone independent accounting date for invoiced project transactions in resource-based deployments. Keeping the intended accounting date consistent across users helps prevent local time zone conversions from shifting the voucher date when transactions are posted in finance and operations.

GA date: February CY2027
